input.plan:
# AOSPA for Nubia Z60 Ultra (cerro) — 调研结论

## 现状

本机工作区 [`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U) **不是 AOSPA 源码树**，只有：

- [`clo-agent-kit/`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit)：cerro 刷机/EDL/关 AVB/硬件笔记（可直接复用）
- `neoteric_caza-14-11-2025-img (3).zip`：一份已能刷的 CLO 类原生 fastboot 包（`require board=pineapple|PQ83A01`）

遵守你的边界：**不查看本机 `/mnt/data/` 下除 `AOSPA_Z60U` 以外的目录**（kit 里提到的 `LOA_Nubia_Z60U` / `ArtistAOSP` 视为禁区）。另一台 `rong@192.168.0.229:/mnt/data/` 的类原生工程，在你确认本计划后只读盘点。

磁盘：`/mnt/data` 约 831G 空闲，放一棵 AOSPA 树 + `out/` 够用，但余量不宽裕，首次 sync 必须 `--depth=1` / `--current-branch --no-tags`。

---

## AOSPA 怎么编（官方）

来源：[AOSPA/manifest](https://github.com/AOSPA/manifest)（default branch **`beryl`**，2026-08 仍在推）、[paranoidandroid.co](https://paranoidandroid.co/)、[AOSPA org](https://github.com/AOSPA)。

| 项 | 结论 |
|---|---|
| 当前分支 | **`beryl`**（README 仍写这个；`vauxite` 是上一世代 A15） |
| 基线 | Qualcomm **CLO / QSSI 16**（`LA.QSSI.16.0`），不是 LineageOS |
| 初始化 | `repo init -u https://github.com/AOSPA/manifest -b beryl` |
| 同步 | `repo sync --current-branch --no-tags -jN` |
| 编译 | 源码根目录 `./rom-build.sh DEVICE`，内部 `lunch aospa_$DEVICE-$BUILD_TYPE`（默认 userdebug） |
| 产物 | `out/target/product/$DEVICE/`，OTA zip 名 `aospa-$AOSPA_VERSION.zip`；`-z` 出 fastboot image zip |

[`vendor/aospa/build.sh`](https://github.com/AOSPA/android_vendor_aospa/blob/beryl/build.sh) 对 **kernel > 5.4** 会走 `kernel_platform/build/android/prepare_vendor.sh`（GKI / CLO kernel_platform）。SM8650 是 6.1 GKI，官方机走这条；非官方移植常常仍用 Lineage 风格的 `TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE`。

AOSPA **没有** Nubia / cerro 官方机。官网机型是 Pixel / Nothing / 部分 Xiaomi / OnePlus 等。官方仓库里已有 **pineapple（SM8650）** 的 powerhint 等平台碎片，但没有 cerro product。

`lunch` 名必须是 `aospa_cerro-userdebug`。没有 `vendor/aospa/products/cerro.mk` + `device/nubia/cerro` 时，`./rom-build.sh cerro` 会直接失败。

---

## 这台机：cerro / caza / NX721J

- 对外型号 **Nubia Z60 Ultra**，代号 **cerro**，板名 **PQ83A01**，SoC **SM8650 / pineapple**
- 工作区 kit 写「部分脚本写 **caza**，同一机」。GitHub 上 [nubia-sm8650-devs](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs) 同时有 `caza`（停在 lineage-22.1）和 `cerro`（lineage-23.2）。应以 **cerro + lineage-23.2** 为准，caza 当旧名
- 刷机硬条件（kit + 社区一致）：
  - Firehose **只用 v1**（`prog_ufs_firehose_sm8650_v1_ddr.elf`）
  - 类原生通常要 **工程 ABL + 关 AVB**；kit 已带 vbmeta
  - A/B 双槽都要刷；`19d2:0112` 是 MemoryDump，不是 9008

硬件事实（改 DT/vendor 时以 [`clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md) 为准）：屏 BF068/RM692H0 1116×2480；触控 Goodix brl-d PID 9916R；WiFi Kiwi v2；扬声器 **2× AW88261**（不是 WSA）；肩键 gpio_keys。这些和 OnePlus pineapple 树差异很大，不能照搬 oplus 音频/触控。

---

## 现成源码（GitHub）

最完整的 cerro 树是 **Lineage 23.2**，不是 AOSPA：

- [nubia-sm8650-devs/android_device_nubia_cerro](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_device_nubia_cerro)（`lineage-23.2`）
- [android_device_nubia_sm8650-common](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_device_nubia_sm8650-common)
- [proprietary_vendor_nubia_cerro](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/proprietary_vendor_nubia_cerro)
- [android_kernel_nubia_sm8650](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_kernel_nubia_sm8650) + modules / devicetrees
- 工程解锁：[nubia_sm8650_eng](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/nubia_sm8650_eng)（kit 里已有一份）

cerro 机专属很薄：继承 common，再加 `oem/boards/cerro_diff.config`、mixer_paths、vendor blobs。分区/内核/模块表都在 **sm8650-common**。

product makefile 关键字段：

```make
PRODUCT_DEVICE := cerro
PRODUCT_MODEL := NX721J
PRODUCT_NAME := lineage_cerro   # AOSPA 侧要改成 aospa_cerro
PRODUCT_SYSTEM_DEVICE := PQ83A01
# inherit vendor/lineage/config/common_full_phone.mk  →  换成 vendor/aospa
```

**最接近的 AOSPA×SM8650 非官方样板**：[oplus-8650-clo](https://github.com/oplus-8650-clo)（「AOSPA for OnePlus SM8650」，分支 `beryl`）。看他们如何把 Lineage 风格 DT 接到 AOSPA：`device/oneplus/sm8650-common`、`android_vendor_aospa` fork、kernel 模块列表、AVB flags。**只能抄接线方式，不能抄 oplus 专属驱动。**

工作区里的 **Neoteric caza zip** 证明这台机已经有能启动的 CLO 用户空间；blobs / 分区表 / fastbootd 流程可对照，但不要假设能直接当 AOSPA device tree。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  aospaOfficial["AOSPA beryl CLO Android16"]
  lineageCerro["nubia-sm8650-devs Lineage 23.2"]
  oplusClo["oplus-8650-clo AOSPA SM8650 接线样板"]
  kit["clo-agent-kit 刷机与硬件事实"]
  remote["192.168.0.229 /mnt/data 类原生树"]
  target["本机 AOSPA_Z60U 非官方 cerro 移植"]
  aospaOfficial --> target
  lineageCerro --> target
  oplusClo --> target
  kit --> target
  remote --> target
```

---

## 为什么不能「sync 完直接编」

AOSPA 是 CLO，Lineage 是 AOSP+CAF 另一套。cerro 现成树大量依赖：

- `vendor/lineage/config/*`、`device/lineage/sepolicy`
- `hardware/qcom-caf/common` 路径
- Lineage 的 `breakfast` / `lineage_cerro.mk`

接到 AOSPA 至少要改：product 名 `aospa_cerro`、继承 `vendor/aospa`、SEPolicy、Soong/HIDL 矩阵、kernel 是走 `kernel_platform` 还是保留 `TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE`、以及 local_manifest 把 nubia device/kernel/vendor 编进树。这是一次 **非官方移植**，工作量远大于装环境和 `repo sync`。

---

## 本机编译环境缺口（只记录，本阶段不装）

- **没有 JDK**（A16 需要 OpenJDK 21）
- Fedora/Evernight + **Python 3.14**：AOSP 脚本经常只认 3.8–3.12，可能要单独放一个 3.12
- `repo` / `adb` / `fastboot` / `gcc` / `make` 已有
- GitHub 同步：kit 写走本机代理 `127.0.0.1:7890`

---

## 确认后本阶段要做的（仍是调研，不 sync 整棵 AOSPA）

1. **只读盘点** `rong@192.168.0.229:/mnt/data/`：有哪些 ROM 树、Android/CLO 版本、是否已有 cerro/caza/nubia/sm8650、local_manifest、`aospa_*.mk` 写法。凭据只用 SSH，不写进仓库。本机禁区目录仍然不碰。
2. 对照远程树 + [oplus-8650-clo](https://github.com/oplus-8650-clo) + Lineage cerro，写一份 **AOSPA 适配对照表**（product / BoardConfig / sepolicy / kernel / blobs）。
3. 估算源码体积与目录布局建议：在 [`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U) 内建源码根，保留 `clo-agent-kit/` 不混进 `.repo`。
4. 产出下一阶段可执行清单（环境包、`repo init`、roomservice.xml 草稿、`aospa_cerro.mk` 骨架）——**等你再批准才下载/改文件**。

# AOSPA calcite (Android 17) for cerro — 调研修订

## 访问边界（已更正）

- **本机**：只看 [`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U)。不看本机 `/mnt/data/` 下其它文件夹。
- **229**（`rong@192.168.0.229`）：`/mnt/data/` **整棵都可以看**，包括 ArtistAOSP 以及其它类原生树。凭据不写入仓库。

## 版本更正：AOSPA 是 Android 17

上一版把 GitHub default branch **`beryl`** 当成当前目标，那是错的。你要的是 Android 17。

| 分支 | AOSPA 世代 | Android | BUILD_ID 证据 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vauxite` | Vauxite | 15 | — | 旧 |
| `beryl` | Beryl | **16** | `BQ2A.260402.002-BP2A.250705.008` + `LA.QSSI.16.0` | GitHub default；README 仍写 `-b beryl` |
| **`calcite`** | **Calcite** | **17** | `CQ2A.260607.001-CP2A.260605.016`（[android-17.0.0_r1](https://source.android.com/docs/setup/reference/build-numbers)） | 2026-08-23 仍在提交（`vendor_aospa`、`device_qcom_common`） |

目标初始化：

```bash
repo init -u https://github.com/AOSPA/manifest -b calcite
repo sync --current-branch --no-tags -jN
./rom-build.sh cerro
```

内部仍是 `lunch aospa_cerro-userdebug`。官方 [products/AndroidProducts.mk (calcite)](https://github.com/AOSPA/android_vendor_aospa/blob/calcite/products/AndroidProducts.mk) **没有** cerro / pineapple / SM8650。最高官方 QCOM 平台清单到 kalama/taro；机型是 Nothing phone1/phone2、部分 Xiaomi/OnePlus/Realme。这是非官方移植。

product 骨架抄官方机，例如 [aospa_phone2.mk](https://github.com/AOSPA/android_vendor_aospa/blob/calcite/products/phone2/aospa_phone2.mk)：

```make
ifeq (aospa_cerro,$(TARGET_PRODUCT))
$(call inherit-product, $(SRC_TARGET_DIR)/product/core_64_bit_only.mk)
$(call inherit-product, $(SRC_TARGET_DIR)/product/aosp_base_telephony.mk)
$(call inherit-product, device/nubia/cerro/device.mk)
$(call inherit-product, vendor/aospa/target/product/aospa-target.mk)
PRODUCT_NAME := aospa_cerro
PRODUCT_DEVICE := cerro
PRODUCT_MODEL := NX721J
endif
```

还要在 `vendor/aospa/products/AndroidProducts.mk` 加 `aospa_cerro.mk`（或用 local_manifest 叠一层，避免直接改官方 vendor）。

---

## 本机工作区

[`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U) 不是源码树：

- [`clo-agent-kit/`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit)：EDL / 关 AVB / 硬件笔记（刷机可复用）
- `neoteric_caza-14-11-2025-img (3).zip`：能刷的 CLO fastboot 包（`board=pineapple|PQ83A01`）

磁盘约 831G 空闲。首次 sync 必须 `--depth=1` / `--current-branch --no-tags`。

---

## 这台机：cerro / NX721J

- Nubia Z60 Ultra，代号 **cerro**，板名 **PQ83A01**，SoC **SM8650 / pineapple**
- kit 里 **caza** 是旧产品名，同一机。GitHub `caza` 停在 lineage-22.1；当前用 **cerro + lineage-23.2**
- 刷机：Firehose **只用 v1**；类原生通常要工程 ABL + 关 AVB；双槽都刷

硬件（[`clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md)）：屏 RM692H0 1116×2480；触控 Goodix brl-d 9916R；WiFi Kiwi v2；扬声器 **2× AW88261**（不是 WSA）。不能照搬 oplus 音频/触控。

---

## GitHub 现成树与版本缺口

cerro 最完整的是 **Lineage 23.2 = Android 16**，比 calcite **低一个大版本**：

- [android_device_nubia_cerro](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_device_nubia_cerro)
- [android_device_nubia_sm8650-common](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_device_nubia_sm8650-common)
- [proprietary_vendor_nubia_cerro](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/proprietary_vendor_nubia_cerro)
- [android_kernel_nubia_sm8650](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_kernel_nubia_sm8650)
- [nubia_sm8650_eng](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/nubia_sm8650_eng)

Lineage 24（A17）已开工，nubia-sm8650-devs **还没有** lineage-24.0 cerro 分支。

[oplus-8650-clo](https://github.com/oplus-8650-clo) 是目前公开的 AOSPA×SM8650 接线样板，但跟的是 **beryl / Android 16**。只能抄「怎么接到 vendor/aospa」，不能当 calcite 成品，也不能抄 oplus 专属驱动。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  aospaCalcite["AOSPA calcite Android17"]
  lineageCerro["nubia-sm8650-devs Lineage 23.2 Android16"]
  oplusClo["oplus-8650-clo AOSPA SM8650 接线 但是beryl"]
  kit["clo-agent-kit 刷机与硬件"]
  remote["229 /mnt/data 全部类原生树"]
  target["本机 AOSPA_Z60U calcite cerro"]
  aospaCalcite --> target
  lineageCerro --> target
  oplusClo --> target
  kit --> target
  remote --> target
```

---

## 229 盘点（进行中）

确认计划执行后立刻只读 SSH，列出 `/mnt/data/` 每棵树：ROM 名、是否 `.repo`、manifest 分支、有无 cerro/caza/nubia/sm8650、local_manifest、`aospa_*.mk`。**ArtistAOSP 在 229 上要看。**

本轮修订已更正版本与访问边界；远程目录清单以下一轮 SSH 结果补进本节。

---

## 为什么不能 sync 完直接编

1. 官方 calcite 没有 cerro product。
2. 现成 DT 是 Lineage 23.2（A16）+ Lineage 继承链，要改成 `vendor/aospa/target/product/aospa-target.mk`。
3. 还要跨一个大版本（A16 DT → A17 CLO）。
4. kernel：官方 calcite 走 `kernel_platform`；非官方 SM8650 样板走 `TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE`。选哪条要对照 229 上已能编过的树。

---

## 本机环境缺口（只记录）

- 无 JDK（A17 仍需较新 OpenJDK，先按 21 准备，以 calcite 文档为准）
- Python 3.14 可能过新，可能要 3.12
- `repo` / adb / fastboot / gcc / make 已有
- 拉 GitHub 走代理 `127.0.0.1:7890`

---

## 确认后仍属调研的下一步

1. SSH 盘点 229 `/mnt/data`（整棵，含 ArtistAOSP），把结果写回本节。
2. 对照远程树写出 calcite 适配表。
3. 目录布局：源码放在 `AOSPA_Z60U` 内，保留 `clo-agent-kit/`。
4. 下一阶段清单：`repo init -b calcite`、roomservice.xml、`aospa_cerro.mk` 骨架——**再批准才下载。**

printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'echo artistycr' > "$ASKPASS"

ssh -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes rong@192.168.0.229 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set +e
export LANG=C
echo "===== DF ====="

du -sh /mnt/data/{aosp,aosp-cf-run,aosp-logs,artist-patches,ArtistAOSP,InfinityX_cerro,InfinityX_cerro_patchs,LOA_Nubia_Z60U,LOA_Nubia_Z60U_backup_20260817_025432,OnlyAOSP,PenguinOS_cerro,backups,agent_phone_tool,userdata} 2>/dev/null

  echo "---- $d ----"
  if [ -d "$d/.repo" ]; then
    echo "HAS_REPO=yes"
    ls "$d/.repo" 2>/dev/null | head
    echo "-- local_manifests --"
    ls -la "$d/.repo/local_manifests" 2>/dev/null
    for f in "$d/.repo/local_manifests"/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      echo "FILE $f"

    echo "-- manifest.xml head --"

    echo "-- manifests.git remote --"
    git -C "$d/.repo/manifests" remote -v 2>/dev/null

    echo "-- default.xml include/remote --"
    grep -E 'remote=|name=|revision=|include' "$d/.repo/manifests/default.xml" 2>/dev/null | head -30
  else
    echo "HAS_REPO=no"
    ls "$d" 2>/dev/null | head -25
  fi
  echo
done
REMOTE
rc=$?
rm -f "$ASKPASS"
exit $rc

    status: completed
isProject: false
---

# AOSPA calcite (Android 17) for cerro — 调研修订

## 访问边界（已更正）

- **本机**：只看 [`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U)。不看本机 `/mnt/data/` 下其它文件夹。
- **229**（`rong@192.168.0.229`）：`/mnt/data/` **整棵都可以看**，包括 ArtistAOSP 以及其它类原生树。凭据不写入仓库。
- 本机 `known_hosts` 已有 229，无 SSH 私钥；密码登录可用。不把凭据写进仓库或本计划。

## 版本更正：AOSPA 是 Android 17

上一版把 GitHub default branch **`beryl`** 当成当前目标，那是错的。你要的是 Android 17。

| 分支 | AOSPA 世代 | Android | BUILD_ID 证据 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vauxite` | Vauxite | 15 | — | 旧 |
| `beryl` | Beryl | **16** | `BQ2A.260402.002-BP2A.250705.008` + `LA.QSSI.16.0` | GitHub default；README 仍写 `-b beryl` |
| **`calcite`** | **Calcite** | **17** | `CQ2A.260607.001-CP2A.260605.016`（[android-17.0.0_r1](https://source.android.com/docs/setup/reference/build-numbers)） | 2026-08-23 仍在提交（`vendor_aospa`、`device_qcom_common`） |

目标初始化：

```bash
repo init -u https://github.com/AOSPA/manifest -b calcite
repo sync --current-branch --no-tags -jN
./rom-build.sh cerro
```

内部仍是 `lunch aospa_cerro-userdebug`。官方 [products/AndroidProducts.mk (calcite)](https://github.com/AOSPA/android_vendor_aospa/blob/calcite/products/AndroidProducts.mk) **没有** cerro / pineapple / SM8650。最高官方 QCOM 平台清单到 kalama/taro；机型是 Nothing phone1/phone2、部分 Xiaomi/OnePlus/Realme。这是非官方移植。

product 骨架抄官方机，例如 [aospa_phone2.mk](https://github.com/AOSPA/android_vendor_aospa/blob/calcite/products/phone2/aospa_phone2.mk)：

```make
ifeq (aospa_cerro,$(TARGET_PRODUCT))
$(call inherit-product, $(SRC_TARGET_DIR)/product/core_64_bit_only.mk)
$(call inherit-product, $(SRC_TARGET_DIR)/product/aosp_base_telephony.mk)
$(call inherit-product, device/nubia/cerro/device.mk)
$(call inherit-product, vendor/aospa/target/product/aospa-target.mk)
PRODUCT_NAME := aospa_cerro
PRODUCT_DEVICE := cerro
PRODUCT_MODEL := NX721J
endif
```

还要在 `vendor/aospa/products/AndroidProducts.mk` 加 `aospa_cerro.mk`（或用 local_manifest 叠一层，避免直接改官方 vendor）。

---

## 本机工作区

[`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U) 不是源码树：

- [`clo-agent-kit/`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit)（451M）：EDL / 关 AVB / 硬件笔记（刷机可复用）
- `neoteric_caza-14-11-2025-img (3).zip`（3.7G）：能刷的 CLO fastboot 包（`board=pineapple|PQ83A01`）

本机 `/mnt/data` **1.6T，已用 724G，空闲 831G（47%）**。229 已满，编译必须在本机。首次 sync 必须 `--depth=1` / `--current-branch --no-tags`。

---

## 这台机：cerro / NX721J

- Nubia Z60 Ultra，代号 **cerro**，板名 **PQ83A01**，SoC **SM8650 / pineapple**
- kit 里 **caza** 是旧产品名，同一机。GitHub `caza` 停在 lineage-22.1；当前用 **cerro + lineage-23.2**
- 刷机：Firehose **只用 v1**；类原生通常要工程 ABL + 关 AVB；双槽都刷

硬件（[`clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md`](/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md)）：屏 RM692H0 1116×2480；触控 Goodix brl-d 9916R；WiFi Kiwi v2；扬声器 **2× AW88261**（不是 WSA）。不能照搬 oplus 音频/触控。

---

## GitHub 现成树与版本缺口

cerro 最完整的是 **Lineage 23.2 = Android 16**，比 calcite **低一个大版本**：

- [android_device_nubia_cerro](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_device_nubia_cerro)
- [android_device_nubia_sm8650-common](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_device_nubia_sm8650-common)
- [proprietary_vendor_nubia_cerro](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/proprietary_vendor_nubia_cerro)
- [android_kernel_nubia_sm8650](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/android_kernel_nubia_sm8650)
- [nubia_sm8650_eng](https://github.com/nubia-sm8650-devs/nubia_sm8650_eng)

Lineage 24（A17）已开工，nubia-sm8650-devs **还没有** lineage-24.0 cerro 分支。

[oplus-8650-clo](https://github.com/oplus-8650-clo) 是目前公开的 AOSPA×SM8650 接线样板，但跟的是 **beryl / Android 16**。只能抄「怎么接到 vendor/aospa」，不能当 calcite 成品，也不能抄 oplus 专属驱动。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  aospaCalcite["AOSPA calcite Android17"]
  lineageCerro["nubia-sm8650-devs Lineage 23.2 Android16"]
  neoClo["229 Neoteric caza CLO A17"]
  voltage["229 VoltageOS 17 cerro 已编过"]
  onlyaosp["229 OnlyAOSP A17 + CAF HAL 清单"]
  oplusClo["oplus-8650-clo AOSPA SM8650 接线 但是beryl"]
  kit["clo-agent-kit 刷机与硬件"]
  target["本机 AOSPA_Z60U calcite cerro"]
  aospaCalcite --> target
  lineageCerro --> target
  neoClo --> target
  voltage --> target
  onlyaosp --> target
  oplusClo --> target
  kit --> target
```

---

## 229 盘点（完成，2026-08-24）

主机 `asus-cachyos-rong`。`/mnt/data` **1.5T，已用 1.4T，空闲 11G（100%）**。系统盘 `/` 也只剩 25G。 **不能再在 229 上 sync 一棵 AOSPA/AOSP 树。** 编译放本机。

### 类原生相关目录

| 路径 | 体积 | 是什么 | 对 calcite 的价值 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/mnt/data/ArtistAOSP` | 648G | PlasmaAOSP，基于 **VoltageOS 17**（`android-17.0.0_r1` / `cp2a`）编 cerro | **A17 已出包**：`voltage-6.0-cerro-20260823-*.zip`。product 接 `vendor/voltage`，DT 仍是 lineage-23.2 |
| `/mnt/data/ArtistAOSP/source` | （含在上） | 真编译树：`lunch voltage_cerro-cp2a-userdebug`，`mka bacon` | 看 `voltage_cerro.mk`、`device.mk`、local_manifest |
| `/mnt/data/ArtistAOSP/neo-reference/source-neoteric-cnb-caza` | （含在 ArtistAOSP） | **Neoteric CLO**，manifest `LA.QSSI.17.0`，`device/nubia/caza` | **架构最像 AOSPA**：`inherit vendor/neoteric/target/product/neoteric-target.mk`。官方 neo A16 能开机；自编 A17 卡第一屏 |
| `/mnt/data/aosp` | 146G | AOSP `android17-release` + OnlyAOSP local_manifests | 干净 A17 上挂 cerro DT 的样板：`lunch onlyaosp_cerro-cp2a-userdebug` |
| `/mnt/data/OnlyAOSP` | 614M | 元仓库：manifest、patches、`vendor/onlyaosp`、脚本 | **CAF HAL 清单最完整**（`cerro-hals.xml`）；不是 AOSPA，但是 AOSP 树缺 Lineage CAF 路径时必抄 |
| `/mnt/data/InfinityX_cerro` | 11G | 包装/日志/脚本，**没有** `.repo` | 参考 Infinity-X 16 的 fetch 脚本；源码目录当时不在 |
| `/mnt/data/PenguinOS_cerro` | 空 | — | 无 |
| `/mnt/data/LOA_Nubia_Z60U` | 91G | 主线 Linux + EDL/工具；clo-agent-kit 来源 | 刷机/主线，不直接编 AOSPA |
| `/mnt/data/LOA_Nubia_Z60U_backup_20260817_025432` | 55G | LOA 备份 | 无 |
| `/mnt/data/aosp-cf-run` | 3.7G | Cuttlefish 镜像 | 无关 |
| `artistaosp-build.swap` 等 | 65G+65G+81G | 编译 swap | 229 盘满的原因之一 |

ArtistAOSP 根目录 `.repo` 是 stub（只有 local_manifests）；真 `.repo` 在 `source/`。真相源：`vendor/plasmaos/`、`devices/nubia/cerro/`、`scripts/apply-all.sh`。旧树：`source-ascp/`（ASCP）、`source-lunaris/`（Lunaris 16.2）。

### 共用 cerro local_manifest（Voltage / OnlyAOSP 一致）

GitHub `nubia-sm8650-devs`，revision **`lineage-23.2`**：

- `device/nubia/{cerro,sm8650-common}`
- `kernel/nubia/sm8650{,-devicetrees,-modules}`
- `vendor/nubia/{cerro,sm8650-common}`

可选：`nukisystems/packages_apps_NubiaParts`（lineage-23.1）。

Voltage 另加 `device/lineage/sepolicy` **lineage-24.0**（A17 sepolicy）。OnlyAOSP 的 sepolicy 仍是 lineage-23.2，但补了整份 CAF HAL。

### Voltage product（已编过）

`device/nubia/cerro/voltage_cerro.mk`：

- inherit `core_64_bit_only` + `full_base_telephony` + `device/nubia/cerro/device.mk` + `vendor/voltage/config/common_full_phone.mk`
- `PRODUCT_NAME := voltage_cerro`，屏 2480×1116，指纹 PQ83A01 Android 15 串
- `AndroidProducts.mk` 仍保留 `lineage_cerro.mk`，并加 `voltage_cerro-cp2a-userdebug`

`device.mk` inherit：`sm8650-common/common.mk`、`hardware/qcom-caf/common`、`vendor/nubia/cerro` + common vendor。

### Neoteric CLO product（架构最近）

`device/nubia/caza/caza.mk`：

```make
$(call inherit-product, vendor/neoteric/target/product/neoteric-target.mk)
$(call inherit-product, device/nubia/caza/pineapple.mk)
PRODUCT_DEVICE := caza
PRODUCT_NAME := caza
```

这就是 AOSPA `aospa-target.mk` 的同构。`pineapple.mk` 自己再 inherit AOSP telephony / VAB / dalvik。BoardConfig 两边都是 **`TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE := kernel/nubia/sm8650`**（不是 `kernel_platform`）。README 明确：官方 neo **A16 能开机**，自编 **A17 卡第一屏**。

### OnlyAOSP HAL 缺口（AOSP/AOSPA 树没有 Lineage CAF 路径时要补）

`cerro-hals.xml` 拉：`device/lineage/sepolicy`、`device/qcom/sepolicy_vndr/sm8650`、`hardware/qcom-caf/{common,bootctrl,thermal,wlan}`、`hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/{audio,display,data*}`、以及 display-commonsys / usb / vibrator / power 等。AOSPA calcite 若已带 CLO QCOM 路径，**不能整份照搬**——先 sync 官方树再 diff 缺什么。

---

| 层 | 用谁 | 接到 calcite 时改什么 |
|---|---|---|
| Product makefile | 抄官方 `aospa_phone2.mk` 骨架；顺序参考 Neoteric `caza.mk` | inherit `aospa-target.mk`，**不要** inherit voltage / lineage / onlyaosp / neoteric。`PRODUCT_NAME := aospa_cerro`。用 local_manifest 叠一层，避免改官方 `vendor/aospa` |
| Device / common | `nubia-sm8650-devs` lineage-23.2 `device/nubia/{cerro,sm8650-common}` | 去掉 `vendor/lineage` 依赖；保留 `device.mk` → common.mk → vendor blobs。屏 1116×2480、指纹 PQ83A01 |
| Kernel | 同上 `kernel/nubia/sm8650{,-modules,-devicetrees}` | 229 已验证路径：`TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE := kernel/nubia/sm8650`。官方 calcite `rom-build.sh` 对 >5.4 会走 `kernel_platform/prepare_vendor.sh`——**优先跟 229 已能编过的 TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE**，不要一上来改 kernel_platform |
| Blobs | `proprietary_vendor_nubia_{cerro,sm8650-common}` lineage-23.2 | 先原样；A17 再按 missing blobs 补 |
| sepolicy | Voltage 用 lineage-24.0 sepolicy；OnlyAOSP 用 23.2 + CAF vndr | calcite 有自己的 qcom sepolicy。先试官方 + 机型 sepolicy；缺 Lineage 宏再按需加 `device/lineage/sepolicy` |

| CLO 接线 | Neoteric `neoteric-target.mk` + oplus-8650-clo（beryl） | 只抄 inherit 顺序和 BoardConfig 开关，不抄 oplus 音频/触控（cerro 是 AW88261 + Goodix） |

| `ArtistAOSP/devices/nubia/cerro/` | **不要当 DT** | 只是产品层真相源（`voltage_cerro.mk`、`plasma_branding.mk`），不是完整设备树 |
| `vendor/plasmaos/device/cerro-opt/` | **参考** | 改良的「配方」：`apply-plasma-cerro-device-opt.sh` 往上面两棵树上打补丁 |

根目录 `devices/nubia/cerro` 和 `source/device/nubia/cerro` 内容不同：前者只有产品/品牌文件，后者才是 repo 里的真设备树。

### Plasma 改了什么（硬件相关，值得保留）

**`device/nubia/cerro`**（相对 upstream 的 git diff）：

- `vendor.prop`：SurfaceFlinger 计时、相机 aux lens（`persist.vendor.camera.use_aux=1`）
- `rootdir/`：相机 bootstrap（`init.cerro.camera.rc` + `.sh`）
- `device.mk`：挂上 camera bootstrap；另有 SukiSU 相关 copy（见下）

**`device/nubia/sm8650-common`**：

- `vendor.prop`：OP12 对齐的 SF / display / perf 调参（`use_smooth_motion=1`、`framepacing` 等）
- `common.mk`：perf XML（`configs/perf/perfboostsconfig.xml` 等）
- `TouchscreenRotation/`：旋转服务逻辑增强
- `sepolicy/`：devicesettings / platform_app 小改
- `BoardConfigCommon.mk`：多了 `vendor/plasmaos_sukisu.config`（**仅 SukiSU 用，AOSPA 默认不要**）
- `rootdir/etc/init.target.rc`：小改

这些在 VoltageOS 17 上已编过，比裸 lineage-23.2 更接近你要的「能用的 cerro」。

### 接到 AOSPA 前要剥掉什么

**不要带进 calcite 树：**

- `voltage_cerro.mk`、`lineage_cerro.mk`、`artist_cerro.mk`、`plasma_branding.mk`
- `plasma_sukisu/`、`device.mk` 里 SukiSU 段、`BoardConfigCommon.mk` 里的 `plasmaos_sukisu.config`（除非你明确要 root）
- `AndroidProducts.mk` 里的 `voltage_cerro-cp2a-userdebug` / `lineage_cerro` lunch
- `lineage.dependencies`（AOSPA 不用 Lineage roomservice 链；可留作参考）
- `overlay/PowerLayers/` 等纯 Plasma 品牌 RRO

**要新建/替换：**

- `aospa_cerro.mk`：inherit `vendor/aospa/target/product/aospa-target.mk`，不 inherit `vendor/voltage`
- `AndroidProducts.mk`：只挂 `aospa_cerro-userdebug`
- `device.mk`：去掉 `vendor/lineage` 相关 inherit（若 calcite 编不过再逐项处理）；保留 camera bootstrap + vendor.prop

### 推荐导入流程（批准后执行）

1. `repo sync` 先把官方 calcite 拉下来（或 roomservice 拉裸 lineage-23.2 DT 作底）
2. 从 229 **rsync/scp** 两棵树到本机 overlay 目录，例如：
   - `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/device-overlay/nubia/cerro/`
   - `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/device-overlay/nubia/sm8650-common/`
3. 在本机跑一遍「剥离脚本」：删 Voltage/Plasma 产品 mk、SukiSU、lineage lunch
4. 用 `local_manifest` 或 `git replace` 让编译树指向 overlay（不要直接改 `.repo` 里的 upstream 裸树，方便以后 diff）
5. 可选：对照 `vendor/plasmaos/device/cerro-opt/` 确认 SF/perf/thermal 补丁都已落在 sm8650-common 里（229 上 `apply-plasma-cerro-device-opt.sh` 已经打过一轮）

**kernel / vendor blobs**：仍跟 229 一样用 `kernel/nubia/sm8650*` + `vendor/nubia/*`（lineage-23.2），Plasma 没改 kernel 树本体，只在 BoardConfig 多过一个 sukisu config。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  plasma229["229 source/device/nubia"]
  strip["剥离 Voltage Plasma SukiSU"]
  overlay["本机 device-overlay"]
  aospa["AOSPA calcite source"]
  product["aospa_cerro.mk"]
  plasma229 --> strip --> overlay --> aospa
  product --> aospa
```

## 适配优先级

1. **229 PlasmaAOSP 改良 DT**（本节）：硬件调参 / 相机 / 触控 / sepolicy，已 A17 验证
2. Neoteric `caza.mk`：CLO product 怎么 inherit `*-target.mk`（A17 没稳定开机）
3. OnlyAOSP `cerro-hals.xml`：sync 完再 diff 缺哪些 HAL，禁止整份 Lineage HAL overlay 顶掉 CLO

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Strip Voltage/Plasma/SukiSU product layers from device-overlay before AOSPA apply.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
CERRO="$ROOT/device-overlay/nubia/cerro"
COMMON="$ROOT/device-overlay/nubia/sm8650-common"

die() { echo "strip-plasma: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ -d "$CERRO" ]] || die "missing $CERRO"
[[ -d "$COMMON" ]] || die "missing $COMMON"

echo "[strip-plasma] cerro=$CERRO"

# --- Remove Plasma/Voltage product files ---
rm -rf \
  "$CERRO/plasma_sukisu" \
  "$CERRO/overlay/PowerLayers" \
  "$CERRO/voltage_cerro.mk" \
  "$CERRO/lineage_cerro.mk" \
  "$CERRO/artist_cerro.mk" \
  "$CERRO/plasma_branding.mk" \
  "$CERRO/lineage.dependencies"

# --- cerro device.mk: drop SukiSU block, keep camera bootstrap ---
cat > "$CERRO/device.mk" <<'EOF'
#
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: The LineageOS Project
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

# Inherit from nubia sm8650-common
$(call inherit-product, device/nubia/sm8650-common/common.mk)

DEVICE_PATH := device/nubia/cerro

# Audio
PRODUCT_COPY_FILES += \
    $(DEVICE_PATH)/audio/mixer_paths_pineapple_mtp.xml:$(TARGET_COPY_OUT_VENDOR)/etc/audio/sku_pineapple/mixer_paths_pineapple_mtp.xml

# Soong
PRODUCT_SOONG_NAMESPACES += \
    $(DEVICE_PATH)

# Overlays
PRODUCT_PACKAGES += \
    SettingsProviderResCerro

# Inherit from proprietary targets
$(call inherit-product, vendor/nubia/cerro/cerro-vendor.mk)

# PlasmaOS: CERRO_CAMERA_BOOTSTRAP (hardware; no root stack)
PRODUCT_COPY_FILES += \
    $(DEVICE_PATH)/rootdir/bin/init.cerro.camera.sh:$(TARGET_COPY_OUT_VENDOR)/bin/init.cerro.camera.sh \
    $(DEVICE_PATH)/rootdir/etc/init.cerro.camera.rc:$(TARGET_COPY_OUT_VENDOR)/etc/init/init.cerro.camera.rc
EOF

# --- AndroidProducts.mk: AOSPA only (aospa_cerro.mk added by apply script) ---
cat > "$CERRO/AndroidProducts.mk" <<'EOF'
#
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: The LineageOS Project
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

PRODUCT_MAKEFILES := \
    $(LOCAL_DIR)/aospa_cerro.mk

COMMON_LUNCH_CHOICES += \
    aospa_cerro-userdebug \
    aospa_cerro-user \
    aospa_cerro-userdebug \
    aospa_cerro-eng
EOF

# --- sm8650-common: remove SukiSU kernel config line ---
if grep -q 'plasmaos_sukisu.config' "$COMMON/BoardConfigCommon.mk"; then
  sed -i '/vendor\/plasmaos_sukisu.config/d' "$COMMON/BoardConfigCommon.mk"
fi

echo "[strip-plasma] done"

#
# AOSPA calcite — Nubia Z60 Ultra (cerro)
# Lunch: aospa_cerro-userdebug
#

$(call inherit-product, $(SRC_TARGET_DIR)/product/core_64_bit_only.mk)
$(call inherit-product, $(SRC_TARGET_DIR)/product/aosp_base_telephony.mk)

$(call inherit-product, device/nubia/cerro/device.mk)

$(call inherit-product, vendor/aospa/target/product/aospa-target.mk)

TARGET_SCREEN_HEIGHT := 2480
TARGET_SCREEN_WIDTH := 1116

PRODUCT_BRAND := nubia
PRODUCT_DEVICE := cerro
PRODUCT_MANUFACTURER := nubia
PRODUCT_MODEL := NX721J
PRODUCT_NAME := aospa_cerro
PRODUCT_SYSTEM_DEVICE := PQ83A01
PRODUCT_SYSTEM_NAME := PQ83A01-UN

PRODUCT_GMS_CLIENTID_BASE := android-zte

PRODUCT_BUILD_PROP_OVERRIDES += \
    BuildDesc="PQ83A01-UN PQ83A01 15 AQ3A.240812.002 20250916.013811 release-keys" \
    BuildFingerprint=nubia/PQ83A01-UN/PQ83A01:15/AQ3A.240812.002/20250916.013811:user/release-keys \
    DeviceName=$(PRODUCT_SYSTEM_DEVICE) \
    DeviceProduct=$(PRODUCT_SYSTEM_NAME)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Apply Plasma-hardened cerro device trees onto a synced AOSPA calcite tree.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
SOURCE="${SOURCE_DIR:-$ROOT/source}"
OVERLAY="$ROOT/device-overlay/nubia"

die() { echo "apply-device-overlay: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

[[ -d "$SOURCE/.repo" ]] || die "no repo tree at $SOURCE — run repo sync first"
[[ -d "$OVERLAY/cerro" ]] || die "missing $OVERLAY/cerro"

echo "[apply-device-overlay] SOURCE=$SOURCE"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/strip-plasma-device-overlay.sh"

for tree in cerro sm8650-common; do
  dst="$SOURCE/device/nubia/$tree"
  [[ -d "$dst" ]] || die "missing synced $dst"
  echo "[apply-device-overlay] rsync $tree"
  rsync -a --delete \
    --exclude='.git' \
    "$OVERLAY/$tree/" "$dst/"
done

# Register aospa_cerro in vendor/aospa if not already present (local overlay only).
PRODUCTS_MK="$SOURCE/vendor/aospa/products/AndroidProducts.mk"
if [[ -f "$PRODUCTS_MK" ]] && ! grep -q 'aospa_cerro.mk' "$PRODUCTS_MK"; then
  echo "[apply-device-overlay] append aospa_cerro to vendor/aospa/products/AndroidProducts.mk"
  cat >> "$PRODUCTS_MK" <<'EOF'

# cerro (unofficial, local overlay)
$(call inherit-product-if-exists, device/nubia/cerro/aospa_cerro.mk)
EOF
fi

echo "[apply-device-overlay] done — lunch aospa_cerro-userdebug"

export HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run after you approve repo sync. Applies overlay when finished.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
SOURCE="$ROOT/source"
JOBS="${1:-$(nproc)}"

# shellcheck source=proxy-env.sh

cd "$SOURCE"
echo "[sync-calcite] repo sync -j$JOBS --current-branch --no-tags"
repo sync --current-branch --no-tags -j"$JOBS"

echo "[sync-calcite] applying device overlay"
bash "$ROOT/scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh"

echo "[sync-calcite] complete"

# AOSPA cerro Agent Guide

给后续 agent 的工作约定。动手前先读本文件；硬件/刷机细节见 [`clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md`](clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md)。

本仓库是 **Nubia Z60 Ultra**（代号 **cerro**，板名 **PQ83A01**，SoC **SM8650 / pineapple**）的 **非官方 AOSPA calcite（Android 17）** 移植工程。

- 目标分支：`calcite`（不是 GitHub default 的 `beryl` / Android 16）
- 目标 lunch：`aospa_cerro-userdebug`
- 官方 AOSPA **没有** cerro 产品；设备树来自 `nubia-sm8650-devs` lineage-23.2，经 229 PlasmaAOSP 改良后 overlay 到本机

---

## 访问边界

| 范围 | 规则 |
|------|------|
| **本机** | 只看 **`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`**。不要浏览本机 `/mnt/data/` 下其它目录（例如本地 LOA、其它 AOSP 副本） |
| **229**（`rong@192.168.0.229`） | `/mnt/data/` 整棵可读作对照（含 ArtistAOSP / OnlyAOSP）。**不要在 229 上 sync**（盘已满） |
| **凭据** | 不要把 SSH 密码、token 写进仓库、计划或脚本 |

编译在本机进行；229 只作只读参考。

---

## 硬性规则

1. **不要把 `source/` 当成设备树真相源。** `source/` 是 AOSPA calcite 检出树，会被 `repo sync` 覆盖。cerro 定制改 **`device-overlay/`** 和 **`scripts/`**，sync 后用 `apply-device-overlay.sh` 重放。
2. **不要直接长期手改 `source/device/nubia/*`**。若必须在 `source/` 里试编，结束后把改动同步回 `device-overlay/`。
3. **`repo sync` 及一切 GitHub 访问必须先开 FlClash 代理**（见下文「网络」）。未开代理不要 sync / fetch。
4. **第一版不带 SukiSU / Plasma 品牌层。** 已从 overlay 剥离：`plasma_sukisu`、`voltage_cerro.mk`、`lineage_cerro.mk` 等。硬件改良（SF/perf、相机 bootstrap、触控旋转）保留。
5. **不要照搬 oplus SM8650 音频/触控。** cerro 是 **AW88261** 扬声器 + **Goodix brl-d** 触控，见 hardware 文档。
6. **不要整份粘贴 OnlyAOSP `cerro-hals.xml`。** AOSPA 是 CLO；sync 完再 diff 缺哪些 Lineage CAF 工程，按需补 `local_manifests`。
7. **不要提交 git commit**，除非用户明确要求。
8. **Firehose 只用 v1**；刷机走 `clo-agent-kit/`（工程 ABL + AVB off + 双槽）。

---

## 目录布局

```
/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/
  AGENTS.md                 # 本文件
  clo-agent-kit/            # EDL / fastboot / 硬件笔记（不进 .repo）
  neoteric_caza-*.zip       # 能开机的 neo A16 fastboot 对照包
  source/                   # repo init -b calcite（AOSPA 主线，可 sync 后很大）
  device-overlay/nubia/     # cerro 设备树真相源（Plasma 改良版，已剥品牌）
    cerro/                  # aospa_cerro.mk、device.mk、BoardConfig、overlay…
    sm8650-common/          # 平台公共树、perf/SF/触控/sepolicy 改良
  scripts/
    proxy-env.sh            # FlClash 127.0.0.1:7890
    strip-plasma-device-overlay.sh
    apply-device-overlay.sh
    sync-calcite.sh         # sync + apply overlay
```

| 路径 | 角色 |
|------|------|
| `device-overlay/` | **设备树真相源**；改这里，不要只改 `source/` |
| `source/.repo/local_manifests/cerro.xml` | 拉 nubia-sm8650-devs device/kernel/vendor（lineage-23.2） |
| `source/` | AOSPA calcite 编译树；`repo sync` 后才有完整内容 |
| `clo-agent-kit/` | 刷机、9008、硬件清单；与 ROM 源码并列，不放进 repo |

---

## 网络（强制）

凡 `repo sync`、`git fetch`、`repo download`、访问 GitHub，**必须先开 FlClash**：

```bash
source /mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/scripts/proxy-env.sh
# HTTP/HTTPS 代理 → 127.0.0.1:7890
```

`scripts/sync-calcite.sh` 已内置 `source proxy-env.sh`。手动操作时也要同样做。仅 `localhost` / 本机 229 SSH 可不走代理。

---

## 标准流程

### 首次 / 增量同步

```bash
# 1. 开 FlClash
source /mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/scripts/proxy-env.sh

# 2. sync + 自动 overlay（用户批准后执行）
bash /mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/scripts/sync-calcite.sh [jobs]
```

`sync-calcite.sh` 等价于：

1. `repo sync --current-branch --no-tags -jN`
2. `bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh`

### 只重放设备树（sync 之后、改过 overlay 时）

```bash
bash /mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh
```

### 编译（sync + overlay 完成后）

```bash
cd /mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/source
source build/envsetup.sh
lunch aospa_cerro-userdebug
# 或 AOSPA 封装：
./rom-build.sh cerro
```

Kernel 路径保持 **`TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE := kernel/nubia/sm8650`**（与 229 Voltage/Neoteric 一致）。不要用 `plasmaos_sukisu.config`。

---

## 设备树策略

1. **基线**：GitHub `nubia-sm8650-devs`，revision **`lineage-23.2`**（`cerro.xml`）
2. **改良来源**：229 `ArtistAOSP/source/device/nubia/{cerro,sm8650-common}`（PlasmaAOSP / VoltageOS 17 已验证）
3. **产品 makefile**：`device-overlay/nubia/cerro/aospa_cerro.mk`  
   - inherit `vendor/aospa/target/product/aospa-target.mk`  
   - **不** inherit `vendor/voltage` / `vendor/lineage`
4. **剥离**：改 overlay 后跑 `strip-plasma-device-overlay.sh`（`apply-device-overlay.sh` 会自动调用）

从 229 更新 overlay 示例（只读）：

```bash
rsync -a --exclude='.git' rong@192.168.0.229:/mnt/data/ArtistAOSP/source/device/nubia/cerro/ \
  /mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/device-overlay/nubia/cerro/
rsync -a --exclude='.git' rong@192.168.0.229:/mnt/data/ArtistAOSP/source/device/nubia/sm8650-common/ \
  /mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/device-overlay/nubia/sm8650-common/
bash /mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/scripts/strip-plasma-device-overlay.sh
```

---

## 参考工程（229，只读）

| 路径 | 用途 |
|------|------|
| `ArtistAOSP/source/` | VoltageOS 17 cerro，**A17 已出包**；DT 接线参考 |
| `ArtistAOSP/neo-reference/source-neoteric-cnb-caza/` | Neoteric CLO，`neoteric-target.mk` ≈ `aospa-target.mk` |
| `OnlyAOSP/manifest/cerro-hals.xml` | AOSP 缺 Lineage CAF 时的对照清单，**勿整份照搬进 CLO** |
| `aosp` + `OnlyAOSP` | `onlyaosp_cerro` A17 样板 |

---

## 本机环境

| 项 | 现状 |
|----|------|
| 磁盘 | `/mnt/data` 约 831G 空闲（够 sync + out） |
| JDK | OpenJDK **25**（仓库无 21；编不过再换） |
| Python | 3.14（AOSP 可能要求 3.12） |
| 工具 | `repo`、adb、fastboot、gcc、make 已有 |

---

## 完成前自检

- [ ] 设备树改动在 `device-overlay/`，不在孤立的 `source/` 手改
- [ ] GitHub / sync 前已 `source scripts/proxy-env.sh`
- [ ] overlay 已剥离 Voltage / Plasma / SukiSU 产品层
- [ ] 未把凭据写入仓库
- [ ] 未浏览本机 `/mnt/data` 其它目录
- [ ] 刷机相关查 `clo-agent-kit/`，不臆造分区/AVB 流程

---

## 常见误区

| 误区 | 正确做法 |
|------|----------|
| 用 `beryl` / Android 16 | 用 **`calcite` / Android 17** |
| 拷 `devices/nubia/cerro`（ArtistAOSP 根） | 拷 **`source/device/nubia/cerro`** 完整树 |
| 在 229 上 sync AOSPA | 只在本机 `AOSPA_Z60U/source` sync |
| 无代理跑 repo sync | 先开 FlClash + `proxy-env.sh` |
| 整份 OnlyAOSP Lineage HAL 进 CLO 树 | sync 后 diff，缺啥补啥 |

# TROUBLESHOOTING

固定排障日志。每次卡住、踩坑、误判必须记在这里（症状 → 试过什么 → 根因 → 解决办法）。不要只记在聊天里。

## 模板

```markdown
### YYYY-MM-DD — 简短标题

- **症状**：
- **环境**：（分支 / lunch / 命令）
- **试过**：
- **根因**：
- **解决**：
```

---

（暂无条目）

# Features

每个功能一篇开发文档：`docs/features/<id>-<slug>.md`。

索引：

| ID | 文档 | 状态 |
|----|------|------|
| — | （尚无） | — |

# AOSPA cerro Agent Guide

给后续 agent 的工作约定。改代码前先读本文件、对应功能文档、以及 [`docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。

本仓库是 **Nubia Z60 Ultra (`cerro`)** 的 **非官方 AOSPA calcite（Android 17）** 移植工程。  
当前主线编译树是 **AOSPA calcite (`source/`)**。设备树真相源在 **`device-overlay/`**（改良自 229 PlasmaAOSP / VoltageOS 17，已剥品牌与 SukiSU）。刷机/硬件见 **`clo-agent-kit/`**。

cerro 定制必须能在上游 `repo sync` 之后用 apply 脚本重新打进去。

内部补丁/开关前缀建议用 **`AOSPA_CERRO_*`**（若引入功能开关文档，放 `docs/aospa-cerro-patch-toggles.md`）。

与 229 PlasmaAOSP 规则对齐：本文件的 **硬性规则、补丁形式、新功能流程、上游重放、完成前自检** 结构同 [`ArtistAOSP/AGENTS.md`](http://192.168.0.229/mnt/data/ArtistAOSP/AGENTS.md)（229 只读对照），下面映射到本仓库路径。

---

## 硬性规则

1. **不要把 `source/` 当成真相源。** 那里只是 AOSPA calcite 编译检出树，随时会被 `repo sync` 覆盖或删掉重下。
2. **修改和新增功能必须以可重放形式落地。** 可编译验证时可以改 `source/`，但结束前必须回写到 `device-overlay/`、`patches/`、`scripts/` 或 apply 脚本，并保证 `bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh`（及后续 `apply-all.sh` 若存在）能从干净树重放。
3. **每做一个功能，必须写一篇功能开发文档**（`docs/features/<id>-<slug>.md`）。文档要让没读过本次对话的 agent 能独立接入。
4. **每次卡住、踩坑、误判，必须记入 `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`。** 记症状、试过的方法、最终原因、解决办法。不要只记在聊天里。
5. **不要直接大段覆盖上游 SystemUI / Settings 来“顺便”带功能。**
6. **不要提交 git commit，除非用户明确要求。**
7. **不要把 cerro 补丁打进无关对照树。** 本机只看 `AOSPA_Z60U`；229 上 ArtistAOSP / OnlyAOSP **只读对照**，不在 229 上 sync。
8. **`repo sync` 及一切 GitHub 访问必须先开 FlClash 代理**（`scripts/proxy-env.sh`）。未开代理不要 sync / fetch。
9. **第一版不带 SukiSU / Plasma / Voltage 产品层。** 硬件改良（SF/perf、相机 bootstrap、触控旋转）保留在 `device-overlay/`；产品层用 `aospa_cerro.mk` + `aospa-target.mk`。

---

## 目录与真相源

| 路径 | 角色 |
|------|------|
| `device-overlay/nubia/cerro/` | cerro 设备树 + **`aospa_cerro.mk`** 真相源（≈ Plasma 的 `devices/nubia/cerro/` + 部分 `source/device`） |
| `device-overlay/nubia/sm8650-common/` | SM8650 平台公共树真相源（Plasma 改良：perf/SF/触控/sepolicy） |
| `patches/` | 根级 unified diff（框架/vendor 改动放这里） |
| `scripts/` | sync / strip / apply / build；**新功能必须挂进 apply 链** |
| `docs/features/` | **每个功能一篇开发文档** |
| `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md` | **固定排障日志** |
| `source/` | **AOSPA calcite** 主线编译树，**可删可重下** |
| `source/.repo/local_manifests/cerro.xml` | nubia-sm8650-devs device/kernel/vendor（lineage-23.2） |
| `clo-agent-kit/` | EDL / fastboot / 硬件笔记（不进 `.repo`） |
| `neoteric_caza-*.zip` | 能开机的 neo A16 fastboot 对照包 |

229 只读参考（**不在本仓库内**）：

| 229 路径 | 用途 |
|----------|------|
| `ArtistAOSP/source/` | VoltageOS 17 cerro，A17 已出包 |
| `ArtistAOSP/vendor/plasmaos/device/cerro-opt/` | 硬件改良配方 |
| `OnlyAOSP/manifest/cerro-hals.xml` | Lineage CAF 对照清单（勿整份搬进 CLO） |

`source/` 里出现的 cerro 改动若还没回写 overlay：

```bash
# 手动 diff 后同步；后续可加 extract 脚本
diff -ru device-overlay/nubia/cerro source/device/nubia/cerro
```

---

## 访问边界

| 范围 | 规则 |
|------|------|
| **本机** | 只看 **`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`**。不要浏览本机 `/mnt/data/` 下其它目录 |
| **229** | `/mnt/data/` 整棵可读；**不要在 229 上 sync**（盘已满） |
| **凭据** | 不要写入仓库、计划或脚本 |

---

## 补丁形式（必须）

按可维护性从高到低选一种。**禁止**只改 `source/` 而不留下可重放产物。

### A. Unified diff（小改动首选）

放 `patches/`，apply 脚本里 `patch -p1` 或 `git apply`。

### B. Python 上下文补丁（易漂移的 Java/Kotlin 首选）

MARKER 用 `// AOSPA cerro: ...`，幂等、可检测、锚点稳定，参数收 `SOURCE_DIR`。

### C. 文件副本 + apply 脚本

设备树整树放 `device-overlay/`，由 `apply-device-overlay.sh` rsync 进 `source/`（当前 cerro 主线做法）。

### D. 明确禁止

- 只改 `source/` 就结束  
- 把补丁打进 229 上的树  
- 整份 OnlyAOSP `cerro-hals.xml` 盖掉 AOSPA CLO 路径  

细节约定：幂等、可检测、锚点稳定、参数收 `SOURCE_DIR`（与 Plasma 相同）。

---

## 新功能标准流程

1. 查重：`docs/features/README.md`、已有 `device-overlay/` / `patches/`
2. 写 `docs/features/<id>-<slug>.md` 草稿
3. 实现到 `device-overlay/` / `patches/` / `scripts/`
4. 挂 apply 链（至少 `apply-device-overlay.sh`；全局改动加进未来的 `apply-all.sh`）
5. 补全文档与 `docs/features/README.md` 索引
6. 验证：`bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh`（sync 后）
7. 踩坑写入 `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`

产品层：lunch **`aospa_cerro-userdebug`**，inherit **`vendor/aospa/target/product/aospa-target.mk`**，不要 inherit `vendor/voltage` / `vendor/lineage`。

---

## 上游更新后如何重放

```bash
# 1. 开 FlClash
source scripts/proxy-env.sh

# 2. sync AOSPA calcite
bash scripts/sync-calcite.sh [jobs]
# 内部：repo sync --current-branch --no-tags → apply-device-overlay.sh

# 3. 若还有框架补丁（未来）
# bash scripts/apply-all.sh
```

只改过 `device-overlay/`、未 sync 时：

```bash
bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh
```

从 229 刷新 Plasma 改良设备树（只读 rsync 后必跑 strip）：

```bash
rsync -a --exclude='.git' rong@192.168.0.229:/mnt/data/ArtistAOSP/source/device/nubia/cerro/ \
  device-overlay/nubia/cerro/
rsync -a --exclude='.git' rong@192.168.0.229:/mnt/data/ArtistAOSP/source/device/nubia/sm8650-common/ \
  device-overlay/nubia/sm8650-common/
bash scripts/strip-plasma-device-overlay.sh
bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh   # 需已 sync
```

---

## 日常命令

```bash
source scripts/proxy-env.sh
bash scripts/sync-calcite.sh              # sync + overlay
bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh      # 仅重放 overlay
bash scripts/strip-plasma-device-overlay.sh

cd source
source build/envsetup.sh
lunch aospa_cerro-userdebug
./rom-build.sh cerro
```

下载 / GitHub **默认走** `scripts/proxy-env.sh`（FlClash `127.0.0.1:7890`）。

Kernel：**`TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE := kernel/nubia/sm8650`**。不要 `plasmaos_sukisu.config`。

---

## AOSPA / cerro 专有条目（Plasma 规则之外的补充）

| 项 | 约定 |
|----|------|
| 分支 | **`calcite`**（Android 17），不是 `beryl` |
| 官方产品 | AOSPA 无 cerro；`local_manifests/cerro.xml` + overlay |
| 音频/触控 | AW88261 + Goodix brl-d；不抄 oplus 驱动 |
| 刷机 | `clo-agent-kit/`：工程 ABL、AVB off、Firehose **v1**、双槽 |
| HAL | sync 后 diff 缺项再补 manifest，禁止整份 Lineage HAL 顶 CLO |

硬件清单：[`clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md`](clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md)。

---

## 完成前自检

- [ ] `source/` 改动已回写 `device-overlay/` / `patches/` / apply 脚本
- [ ] 干净树上 `apply-device-overlay.sh` 可重放（sync 后）
- [ ] `docs/features/` 与索引已更新（若有新功能）
- [ ] 坑已写入 `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`
- [ ] GitHub / sync 前已 `source scripts/proxy-env.sh`
- [ ] overlay 无 Voltage / Plasma / SukiSU 产品层
- [ ] 未浏览本机 `/mnt/data` 其它目录；未在 229 上 sync
- [ ] lunch 为 **`aospa_cerro-*`**，不是 `voltage_cerro` / `lineage_cerro`

  AOSPA 已有、禁止覆盖：

    device/qcom/sepolicy_vndr
    vendor/qcom/opensource/{usb,power,vibrator,data-ipa-cfg-mgr,dataipa,commonsys*}

  仅补 Lineage DT 硬编码的 hardware/qcom-caf/* 路径 + sepolicy/interfaces。
-->
<manifest>
  <remote name="github" fetch="https://github.com" />

  <project path="device/lineage/sepolicy"
           name="LineageOS/android_device_lineage_sepolicy"
           remote="github"
           revision="lineage-24.0" />

           remote="github"

    <linkfile src="os_pickup_qssi.bp" dest="hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/Android.bp" />
  </project>

  <!-- SM8650 audio / display / data（Lineage CAF 路径，DT 硬编码） -->
  <project path="hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/audio/agm"

           remote="github"

  <project path="hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/audio/pal"

           remote="github"
           revision="lineage-23.2-caf-sm8650" />
  <project path="hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/audio/primary-hal"

# 0001 — cerro Lineage CAF HAL 缺口

## 问题

AOSPA calcite 是 CLO 树：QCOM HAL 在 `hardware/qcom/` 和 `vendor/qcom/opensource/`。
cerro 设备树（nubia-sm8650-devs lineage-23.2）硬编码 `hardware/qcom-caf/{common,sm8650/...}`。
`lunch aospa_cerro-userdebug` 立刻失败：`hardware/qcom-caf/common/common.mk does not exist`。

## 决策

对照 229 OnlyAOSP `cerro-hals.xml` **按缺项补**，禁止整份 overlay：

**不拉（AOSPA 已有）**

- `hardware/qcom/bootctrl`、`hardware/qcom/wlan`
- `device/qcom/sepolicy_vndr`（CLO 路径；OnlyAOSP 的 `sm8650` 子路径会顶掉）
- `vendor/qcom/opensource/{usb,power,vibrator,data-ipa-cfg-mgr,dataipa,commonsys*}`
- `hardware/lineage/compat`（AOSPA 自己的）

**要拉（DT 硬编码缺失）**

见 `source/.repo/local_manifests/cerro-hals.xml`。

`device/lineage/sepolicy` 用 **lineage-24.0**（与 229 VoltageOS 17 一致），其余 CAF 用 lineage-23.2 / `lineage-23.2-caf-sm8650`。

## 重放

```bash
source scripts/proxy-env.sh
repo sync --current-branch --no-tags -j4 \
  hardware/qcom-caf/common \
  hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/audio/agm \
  hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/audio/graphservices \
  hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/audio/pal \
  hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/audio/primary-hal \
  hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/data-ipa-cfg-mgr \
  hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/dataipa \
  hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/display \
  hardware/lineage/interfaces \
  device/lineage/sepolicy \
  vendor/qcom/opensource/audio-hal/st-hal-ar-legacy \
  packages/resources/devicesettings
```

`linkfile`：`hardware/qcom-caf/common` 的 `os_pickup_qssi.bp` → `hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/Android.bp`。
**不要**用 OnlyAOSP 那两条会覆盖 `hardware/qcom/Android.mk` / `device/qcom/sepolicy_vndr/SEPolicy.mk` 的 linkfile。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Isolate Lineage CAF common + drop duplicate lineage health AIDL.

AOSPA already defines the same Soong modules in device/qcom/common and
vendor/aospa/interfaces/health. Lineage's hardware/qcom-caf/common/Android.bp
must live in a soong_namespace (os_pickup.bp). Lineage health AIDL duplicates
AOSPA's vendor.lineage.health.

Idempotent. SOURCE_DIR defaults to repo source/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("SOURCE_DIR", ROOT / "source"))

CAF_BP = SOURCE / "hardware/qcom-caf/common/Android.bp"
HEALTH_AIDL = SOURCE / "hardware/lineage/interfaces/health/aidl/Android.bp"
HEALTH_DEFAULT = SOURCE / "hardware/lineage/interfaces/health/aidl/default/Android.bp"

NS = "soong_namespace {\n}\n\n"
MARKER = "// AOSPA cerro: soong_namespace isolates duplicate rfs/mountpoint modules"


def isolate_caf_common() -> None:
    if not CAF_BP.is_file():
        print(f"[soong-isolate] skip missing {CAF_BP}")
        return
    text = CAF_BP.read_text()
    if MARKER in text or text.lstrip().startswith("soong_namespace"):
        print("[soong-isolate] CAF common already namespaced")
        return
    CAF_BP.write_text(f"{MARKER}\n{NS}{text}")
    print("[soong-isolate] wrapped hardware/qcom-caf/common/Android.bp")


def disable_duplicate_health() -> None:
    for path in (HEALTH_AIDL, HEALTH_DEFAULT):
        if not path.is_file():
            print(f"[soong-isolate] skip missing {path}")
            continue
        text = path.read_text()
        if "AOSPA cerro: disabled duplicate" in text:
            print(f"[soong-isolate] already disabled {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")
            continue
        path.write_text(
            "// AOSPA cerro: disabled duplicate of vendor/aospa/interfaces/health\n"
            "/*\n"
            + text
            + "\n*/\n"
        )
        print(f"[soong-isolate] disabled {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")


def main() -> None:
    isolate_caf_common()
    disable_duplicate_health()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Drop Soong modules that duplicate AOSPA CLO definitions.

hardware/qcom-caf/common/Android.bp cannot be wrapped in soong_namespace:
Soong requires the namespace to be the first module, which would hide
qti_kernel_headers / audio_kernel_headers from hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650
(itself a namespace via os_pickup_qssi.bp). Keep those headers in the
root namespace; drop rfs/mountpoint/duplicate HIDL only.

fwk-detect + memtrack subdirs also duplicate CLO. Lineage health AIDL
duplicates vendor/aospa/interfaces/health — replace those Android.bp
with stubs (comment-wrapping fails: inner */ closes the outer comment).

Idempotent. SOURCE_DIR defaults to repo source/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("SOURCE_DIR", ROOT / "source"))

CAF_BP = SOURCE / "hardware/qcom-caf/common/Android.bp"
CAF_MARKER = (
    "// AOSPA cerro: dropped duplicate rfs/mountpoint/hidl "
    "(kernel headers stay in root namespace)"
)
DROP_HIDL = {
    "hidl_vendor_qti_hardware_iop_interface",
    "hidl_vendor_qti_hardware_limits_interface",
    "hidl_vendor_qti_hardware_sigma_miracast_interface",
}
STUB_TARGETS = (
    (
        SOURCE / "hardware/qcom-caf/common/fwk-detect/Android.bp",
        "disabled duplicate of vendor/qcom/opensource/core-utils/fwk-detect",
    ),
    (
        SOURCE / "hardware/qcom-caf/common/memtrack/Android.bp",
        "disabled duplicate of device/qcom/vendor-common/memtrack",
    ),
    (
        SOURCE / "hardware/lineage/interfaces/health/aidl/Android.bp",
        "disabled duplicate of vendor/aospa/interfaces/health",
    ),
    (
        SOURCE / "hardware/lineage/interfaces/health/aidl/default/Android.bp",
        "disabled duplicate of vendor/aospa/interfaces/health",
    ),
)


def git_restore(path: Path) -> bool:
    if not path.is_file():
        return False
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "checkout", "--", path.name],
        cwd=path.parent,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"[soong-isolate] git checkout failed for {path}: {r.stderr.strip()}")
        return False
    print(f"[soong-isolate] restored {path.relative_to(SOURCE)} from git")
    return True


def split_top_level_blocks(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Split Android.bp into comment/header chunks and brace-balanced modules."""
    chunks: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    while i < n:
        while i < n and text[i] in " \t\r\n":
            i += 1
        if i >= n:
            break
        start = i
        if text.startswith("//", i):
            nl = text.find("\n", i)
            i = n if nl < 0 else nl + 1
            chunks.append(text[start:i])
            continue
        if text.startswith("/*", i):
            end = text.find("*/", i + 2)
            i = n if end < 0 else end + 2
            if i < n and text[i] == "\n":
                i += 1
            chunks.append(text[start:i])
            continue
        brace = text.find("{", i)
        if brace < 0:
            chunks.append(text[i:])
            break
        depth = 0
        j = brace
        while j < n:
            if text[j] == "{":
                depth += 1
            elif text[j] == "}":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    j += 1
                    break
            j += 1
        if j < n and text[j] == "\n":
            j += 1
        chunks.append(text[start:j])
        i = j
    return chunks


def module_type_and_name(block: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
    stripped = block.lstrip()
    if stripped.startswith("//") or stripped.startswith("/*"):
        return None, None
    brace = stripped.find("{")
    if brace < 0:
        return None, None
    mtype = stripped[:brace].strip()
    name = None
    for line in stripped.splitlines():
        line = line.strip().rstrip(",")
        if line.startswith("name:"):
            raw = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip().strip(",")
            if raw.startswith('"') and raw.endswith('"'):
                name = raw[1:-1]
            break
    return mtype, name


def strip_caf_duplicates(text: str) -> str:
    kept: list[str] = []
    for block in split_top_level_blocks(text):
        mtype, name = module_type_and_name(block)
        if mtype in ("install_symlink", "mkdir"):
            continue
        if mtype == "prebuilt_hidl_interfaces" and name in DROP_HIDL:
            continue
        kept.append(block)
    out = "".join(kept)
    if not out.endswith("\n"):
        out += "\n"
    return out


def isolate_caf_common() -> None:
    if not CAF_BP.is_file():
        print(f"[soong-isolate] skip missing {CAF_BP}")
        return
    text = CAF_BP.read_text()
    if CAF_MARKER in text:
        print("[soong-isolate] CAF common already stripped")
        return
    if "soong_namespace" in text[:500] and "rfs_apq_gnss" in text:
        git_restore(CAF_BP)
        text = CAF_BP.read_text()
    CAF_BP.write_text(CAF_MARKER + "\n" + strip_caf_duplicates(text))
    print("[soong-isolate] stripped duplicate modules from hardware/qcom-caf/common/Android.bp")


def is_stub(text: str, reason: str) -> bool:
    if reason not in text:
        return False
    _, name = module_type_and_name(text)
    return name is None


def stub_file(path: Path, reason: str) -> None:
    if not path.is_file():
        print(f"[soong-isolate] skip missing {path}")
        return
    text = path.read_text()
    stub = f"// AOSPA cerro: {reason}\n"
    if is_stub(text, reason):
        print(f"[soong-isolate] already stubbed {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")
        return
    if "AOSPA cerro:" in text:
        # Previous comment-wrap still parsed as modules; replace.
        path.write_text(stub)
        print(f"[soong-isolate] replaced broken wrap {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")
        return
    path.write_text(stub)
    print(f"[soong-isolate] stubbed {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")


def main() -> None:
    isolate_caf_common()
    for path, reason in STUB_TARGETS:
        stub_file(path, reason)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

- `hardware/qcom-caf/common/fwk-detect` 与 `vendor/qcom/opensource/core-utils/fwk-detect` 重复
- `hardware/qcom-caf/common/memtrack` 与 `device/qcom/vendor-common/memtrack` 重复
- `hardware/lineage/interfaces/health` 与 `vendor/aospa/interfaces/health` 重复 `vendor.lineage.health` / `vendor.lineage.health-service.default`

DT 仍需要 CAF common 里的 **内核头**（`qti_kernel_headers`、`audio_kernel_headers` 等）和 **libqti-perfd-client**（已有独立 `soong_namespace` + `PRODUCT_SOONG_NAMESPACES`）。触控 / LiveDisplay 仍走 `hardware/lineage/interfaces`，不要整仓丢掉。

## 决策

不要把 `hardware/qcom-caf/common/Android.bp` 整文件换成 Lineage `os_pickup.bp`，也不要在文件头加 `soong_namespace {}`：

1. Soong 规定 **namespace 必须是该 Android.bp 的第一个模块**。
2. `hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650` 的 `Android.bp` 已是 `os_pickup_qssi.bp` namespace，只隐式看见 **root** namespace。把头文件放进 CAF common namespace 后，display/audio 会找不到 `qti_kernel_headers`。

做法：`scripts/patch-soong-isolate-caf-common.py`（挂在 `apply-device-overlay.sh` 末尾）

- CAF `Android.bp`：删除全部 `install_symlink` / `mkdir`，以及与 CLO 同名的三个 HIDL（`iop` / `limits` / `sigma_miracast`）。其余 HIDL 名与 CLO 不同，保留。
- `fwk-detect/Android.bp`、`memtrack/Android.bp`、Lineage health 两份 `Android.bp`：换成一行 stub。不要用 `/* ... */` 包原文（内层版权 `*/` 会提前结束注释，模块仍会被解析）。

`PRODUCT_PACKAGES += vendor.lineage.health-service.default` 保留，改用 AOSPA 那份实现。

## 重放

```bash
bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh
```

`repo sync` 会还原 CAF / lineage interfaces 的 git 文件；sync 后必须再跑 apply（`scripts/sync-calcite.sh` 已调用）。

## 验证

- `hardware/qcom-caf/common/Android.bp` 含 `qti_kernel_headers`，不含 `rfs_apq_gnss_hlos_symlink`
- `hardware/lineage/interfaces/health/aidl/Android.bp` 只有 `// AOSPA cerro:` stub
- soong bootstrap 不再报这些 `already defined`

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Point CLO vendor display imports at Lineage CAF sm8650 namespaces.

AOSPA vendor/qcom/common Android.bp files import hardware/qcom/display{,/gralloc,/libdebug}
which official AOSPA platform xmls ship. calcite has no pineapple display project.
cerro uses hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/display instead.

os_pickup_qssi.bp (linked as hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/Android.bp) also imports
vendor/qcom/opensource/display which is not in this tree.

Idempotent. SOURCE_DIR defaults to repo source/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("SOURCE_DIR", ROOT / "source"))

NS_MARKER = "// AOSPA cerro: soong_namespace for vendor/qcom/common display imports"
NS_BLOCK = f"{NS_MARKER}\nsoong_namespace {{\n}}\n\n"

QSSI_BP = SOURCE / "hardware/qcom-caf/common/os_pickup_qssi.bp"
QSSI_MARKER = "// AOSPA cerro: import CAF display namespaces, not missing opensource/display"
QSSI_BODY = """soong_namespace {
    imports: [
        "vendor/qcom/opensource/commonsys-intf/display",
        "hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/display/gralloc",
        "hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/display/libdebug",
    ],
}
"""

CAF_NS_FILES = (
    SOURCE / "hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/display/gralloc/Android.bp",
    SOURCE / "hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/display/libdebug/Android.bp",
)

VENDOR_COMMON = SOURCE / "vendor/qcom/common"
IMPORT_REPLACEMENTS = (
    ('"hardware/qcom/display/gralloc"', '"hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/display/gralloc"'),
    ('"hardware/qcom/display/libdebug"', '"hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650/display/libdebug"'),
    ('"hardware/qcom/display"', '"hardware/qcom-caf/sm8650"'),
)


def ensure_namespace_first(path: Path) -> None:
    if not path.is_file():
        print(f"[soong-display] skip missing {path}")
        return
    text = path.read_text()
    if NS_MARKER in text:
        print(f"[soong-display] already namespaced {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")
        return
    path.write_text(NS_BLOCK + text)
    print(f"[soong-display] namespaced {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")


def patch_qssi() -> None:
    if not QSSI_BP.is_file():
        print(f"[soong-display] skip missing {QSSI_BP}")
        return
    text = QSSI_BP.read_text()
    if QSSI_MARKER in text:
        print("[soong-display] os_pickup_qssi.bp already patched")
        return
    QSSI_BP.write_text(QSSI_MARKER + "\n" + QSSI_BODY)
    print("[soong-display] patched hardware/qcom-caf/common/os_pickup_qssi.bp")


def patch_vendor_imports() -> None:
    if not VENDOR_COMMON.is_dir():
        print(f"[soong-display] skip missing {VENDOR_COMMON}")
        return
    n = 0
    for bp in VENDOR_COMMON.rglob("Android.bp"):
        text = bp.read_text()
        orig = text
        for old, new in IMPORT_REPLACEMENTS:
            text = text.replace(old, new)
        if text != orig:
            bp.write_text(text)
            n += 1
            print(f"[soong-display] retargeted {bp.relative_to(SOURCE)}")
    if n == 0:
        print("[soong-display] vendor/qcom/common imports already retargeted")


def main() -> None:
    for path in CAF_NS_FILES:
        ensure_namespace_first(path)
    patch_qssi()
    patch_vendor_imports()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def ensure_namespace_first(path: Path) -> None:
    if not path.is_file():
        print(f"[soong-display] skip missing {path}")
        return
    text = path.read_text()
    if text.startswith(NS_BLOCK):
        print(f"[soong-display] already namespaced {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")
        return
    if NS_MARKER in text:
        rest = text.split("\n\n", 1)[-1]
        if rest.lstrip().startswith("//lib") or rest.lstrip().startswith("cc_"):
            path.write_text(NS_BLOCK + rest)
        else:
            # drop previous marker+soong_namespace{...} then prepend
            idx = text.find("soong_namespace")
            brace = text.find("}", idx)
            rest = text[brace + 1 :].lstrip("\n")
            path.write_text(NS_BLOCK + rest)
        print(f"[soong-display] updated namespace imports {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")
        return
    path.write_text(NS_BLOCK + text)
    print(f"[soong-display] namespaced {path.relative_to(SOURCE)}")

def disable_nubia_fm_prebuilt() -> None:
    """AOSPA ships vendor.qti.hardware.fm@1.0 on system_ext; nubia extract-utils puts it on vendor."""

229 已经用上，密码没有写进仓库或脚本。OnlyAOSP 的 `cerro-hals.xml` 也对照过了：除了那两条会盖掉 CLO 的 `os_pickup` mk，display 路径和我们现在的精简清单一致。

上一轮 `./rom-build.sh cerro -j 4` 在 Soong 里失败（CAF `rfs_*` / Lineage health 与 AOSPA 重复）。那批已经按可重放脚本修掉。接着又过了缺失的 `hardware/qcom/display` namespace。

编译还在 soong bootstrap 失败，现在剩两个新缺口：

# Lineage libprotobuf-cpp-full-21.7

Copied from 229 `ArtistAOSP/source/hardware/lineage/compat/libprotobuf/{arm,arm64}/`.
Do **not** overlay the whole Lineage `hardware/lineage/compat` tree — AOSPA already has that project (3.9.1 / v29 only).

Apply: `scripts/patch-lineage-compat-protobuf.py` (called from `apply-device-overlay.sh`).

# 0004 — nubia vendor protobuf 21.7 + NubiaParts resources

## 问题

soong namespace / FM 分区修完后：

- `vendor/nubia/*/Android.bp`：`undefined module "libprotobuf-cpp-full-21.7"`
- `device/nubia/sm8650-common/parts/Android.bp`：`undefined module "org.lineageos.settings.resources"`

## 决策

**protobuf**：Lineage 把它放在 `hardware/lineage/compat` 的预编译 `.so`（SONAME `libprotobuf-cpp-full-21.7.so`）。AOSPA 已有 `hardware/lineage/compat`，但只有 3.9.1 / v29 vendorcompat。**禁止**整仓覆盖 Lineage compat。从 229 Voltage 的 compat 只拷 `arm`/`arm64` 两份 `.so` 到 `prebuilts-cerro/libprotobuf-cpp-full-21.7/`，apply 时装进 AOSPA compat 并追加模块。

不能做成 `libprotobuf-cpp-full` 的 soong 别名：blob 的 `DT_NEEDED` 要的是 `libprotobuf-cpp-full-21.7.so`。

**NubiaParts**：AOSPA 把同仓 `packages/resources/devicesettings` 的模块名改成了 `co.aospa.resources`。overlay `parts/Android.bp` 改 static_libs。NubiaParts 目前不在 `PRODUCT_PACKAGES`，但 Soong 仍会解析该 `android_app`。风扇/扳机是硬件相关，保留源码。

## 重放

```bash
bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh
```

`repo sync` 会还原 `hardware/lineage/compat`；必须再跑 apply。

def inject_gps_legacy_nubia_import() -> None:
    """gps-legacy blobs need libgps.utils from the cerro DT namespace."""
    bp = SOURCE / "vendor/qcom/common/vendor/gps-legacy/Android.bp"

    old = '        "vendor/qcom/common/vendor/qseecomd",'
    new = old + f'\n        "{extra}",'
    if old not in text:
        print("[soong-display] gps-legacy import block changed, skip")
        return
    bp.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
    print("[soong-display] gps-legacy imports device/nubia/sm8650-common")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add Lineage-style libqtivibratoreffect_headers to AOSPA CLO vibrator.

cerro overlay builds libqtivibratoreffect.nubia_sm8650-richtap against that
header module. AOSPA vendor/qcom/opensource/vibrator only exports includes
from the shared lib, not a cc_library_headers.

Do not overlay the whole Lineage vibrator tree (AIDL layout differs).

Idempotent. SOURCE_DIR defaults to repo source/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("SOURCE_DIR", ROOT / "source"))
BP = SOURCE / "vendor/qcom/opensource/vibrator/effect/Android.bp"
MARKER = "// AOSPA cerro: headers module for nubia richtap effect lib"
HEADERS = f"""
{MARKER}
cc_library_headers {{
    name: "libqtivibratoreffect_headers",
    vendor: true,
    export_include_dirs: ["."],
}}
"""


def main() -> None:
    if not BP.is_file():
        print(f"[vibrator-headers] skip missing {BP}")
        return
    text = BP.read_text()
    if MARKER in text or 'name: "libqtivibratoreffect_headers"' in text:
        print("[vibrator-headers] Android.bp already has libqtivibratoreffect_headers")
        return
    needle = 'Common_CFlags += ["-Werror"]\n'
    if needle not in text:
        print("[vibrator-headers] unexpected Android.bp layout, append at top")
        BP.write_text(HEADERS.lstrip() + text)
        return
    BP.write_text(text.replace(needle, needle + HEADERS, 1))
    print("[vibrator-headers] added libqtivibratoreffect_headers")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# 0005 — CLO vibrator 补 libqtivibratoreffect_headers

## 问题

soong：`libqtivibratoreffect.nubia_sm8650-richtap` 依赖 `libqtivibratoreffect_headers`。
Lineage / Voltage 的 `vendor/qcom/opensource/vibrator/effect/Android.bp` 有这份 `cc_library_headers`。
AOSPA CLO 同仓只有 `libqtivibratoreffect` 共享库（`export_include_dirs`），没有 headers 模块名。

## 决策

**禁止**整份覆盖 Lineage vibrator：Voltage/Lineage AIDL 已拆成 `vibratorOL` / `vibratorSel` 等，AOSPA calcite 仍是单份 `vendor.qti.hardware.vibrator.impl`，并硬链 `libqtivibratoreffect`。
只在 CLO `effect/Android.bp` 插入 headers 模块，脚本 `scripts/patch-soong-vibrator-headers.py`。overlay 的 richtap `Android.bp` 保持 Plasma 原样（下次从 229 rsync 不会丢补丁）。

AOSPA AIDL **尚未**消费 `soong_config qti_vibrator`（`effect_lib` / `use_effect_stream`）。common.mk 里那两行现在只保证 Soong 能解析 richtap 库；运行时服务仍链默认 `libqtivibratoreffect`，要等后续专门接 AIDL。

## 重放

```bash
bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh
```

`repo sync` 会还原 `vendor/qcom/opensource/vibrator`；必须再跑 apply。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install Lineage libinput_shim into AOSPA hardware/lineage/compat.

libwfdnative (nubia system_ext blob) DT_NEEDED this shim. AOSPA compat
never shipped libinput/. Do not overlay the whole Lineage compat tree.

Idempotent. SOURCE_DIR defaults to repo source/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("SOURCE_DIR", ROOT / "source"))
PREBUILT = ROOT / "prebuilts-cerro/libinput_shim"
COMPAT = SOURCE / "hardware/lineage/compat"
BP = COMPAT / "Android.bp"
MARKER = "// AOSPA cerro: libinput_shim for nubia libwfdnative"

MODULE = f"""
{MARKER}
cc_library {{
    name: "libinput_shim",
    srcs: [
        "libinput/android_view_KeyEvent.cpp",
        "libinput/Input.cpp",
    ],
    include_dirs: [
        "frameworks/native/include",
        "frameworks/native/libs/ui/include",
    ],
    shared_libs: [
        "libandroid_runtime",
        "libinput",
    ],
    compile_multilib: "64",
    system_ext_specific: true,
}}
"""

SOURCES = ("Input.cpp", "android_view_KeyEvent.cpp")


def copy_srcs() -> None:
    dst_dir = COMPAT / "libinput"
    dst_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name in SOURCES:
        src = PREBUILT / name
        if not src.is_file():
            print(f"[libinput-shim] skip missing {src}")
            continue
        dst = dst_dir / name
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
        print(f"[libinput-shim] installed {dst.relative_to(SOURCE)}")


def append_bp() -> None:
    if not BP.is_file():
        print(f"[libinput-shim] skip missing {BP}")
        return
    text = BP.read_text()
    if MARKER in text or 'name: "libinput_shim"' in text:
        print("[libinput-shim] Android.bp already has libinput_shim")
        return
    BP.write_text(text.rstrip() + "\n" + MODULE)
    print("[libinput-shim] appended module to hardware/lineage/compat/Android.bp")


def main() -> None:
    if not COMPAT.is_dir():
        print(f"[libinput-shim] skip missing {COMPAT}")
        return
    copy_srcs()
    append_bp()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Lineage libinput_shim

Copied from 229 `ArtistAOSP/source/hardware/lineage/compat/libinput/`.
AOSPA `hardware/lineage/compat` does not ship this shim; `libwfdnative` DT_NEEDED it.

Apply: `scripts/patch-lineage-compat-libinput-shim.py`.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Disable vendor/nxp QTI authsecret HAL that collides with AOSP hardware/nxp.

Both install vendor/etc/init/android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp.rc
(and the same vintf fragment name). The QTI binary was renamed to
android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp-qti but still uses the AOSP rc/xml
stems. cerro/pineapple has TARGET_USES_ESE_KEYMINT := false (QTI TEE keymint).

Do not overlay the whole vendor/nxp tree.

Idempotent. SOURCE_DIR defaults to repo source/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("SOURCE_DIR", ROOT / "source"))
BP = (
    SOURCE
    / "vendor/nxp/opensource/keymaster/keymint/KM300/authsecret/Android.bp"
)
MARKER = "// AOSPA cerro: disabled; init_rc/vintf collide with hardware/nxp"


def main() -> None:
    if not BP.is_file():
        print(f"[nxp-authsecret] skip missing {BP}")
        return
    text = BP.read_text()
    if MARKER in text:
        print("[nxp-authsecret] already disabled nxp-qti authsecret")
        return
    old = """cc_binary {
    name: "android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp-qti",
    relative_install_path: "hw",
    init_rc: ["android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp.rc"],
    vintf_fragments: ["android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp.xml"],
    vendor: true,
"""
    new = f"""cc_binary {{
    name: "android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp-qti",
    {MARKER}
    enabled: false,
    relative_install_path: "hw",
    init_rc: ["android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp.rc"],
    vintf_fragments: ["android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp.xml"],
    vendor: true,
"""
    if old not in text:
        print("[nxp-authsecret] unexpected Android.bp layout")
        return
    BP.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
    print("[nxp-authsecret] disabled android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp-qti")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# 0010 — 关掉与 AOSP 撞 init_rc 的 NXP QTI authsecret

## 问题

kati：`overriding commands for target vendor/etc/init/android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp.rc`

两份 HAL 都往这个路径装 rc / vintf：

- `hardware/nxp/keymint/.../android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp`
- `vendor/nxp/opensource/keymaster/.../android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp-qti`（binary 改了名，**rc/xml 文件名没改**）

## 决策

cerro 是 pineapple，`keymint_vendor_board.mk` 已 `TARGET_USES_ESE_KEYMINT := false`（用 QTI TEE `keymint-service-qti`，不是 NXP strongbox）。
Soong 仍会给未 `enabled: false` 的 vendor binary 生成 install 规则，所以即使用户没 PACKAGE 这份 HAL 也会撞文件。

`scripts/patch-soong-nxp-authsecret.py` 给 QTI 那份 `enabled: false`。不要整仓覆盖 `vendor/nxp`。若以后真要 eSE strongbox，应给 QTI 的 rc/xml 改独立文件名再打开。

## 重放

```bash
bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Disable vendor/nxp QTI eSE KeyMint HALs that collide with AOSP hardware/nxp.

QTI binaries were renamed (*-qti / *-nxp) but init_rc / vintf still use the
AOSP filenames, so kati sees duplicate install rules even when
TARGET_USES_ESE_KEYMINT is false (pineapple / cerro uses QTI TEE keymint).

Do not overlay the whole vendor/nxp tree.

Idempotent. SOURCE_DIR defaults to repo source/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("SOURCE_DIR", ROOT / "source"))

TARGETS = (
    (
        SOURCE
        / "vendor/nxp/opensource/keymaster/keymint/KM300/authsecret/Android.bp",
        'name: "android.hardware.authsecret-service.nxp-qti"',
        "// AOSPA cerro: disabled; init_rc/vintf collide with hardware/nxp",
    ),
    (
        SOURCE / "vendor/nxp/opensource/keymaster/keymint/KM300/Android.bp",
        'name: "android.hardware.security.keymint-service.strongbox-nxp"',
        "// AOSPA cerro: disabled; init_rc collides with hardware/nxp KM200",
    ),
)


def disable_binary(bp: Path, name_line: str, marker: str) -> None:
    if not bp.is_file():
        print(f"[nxp-ese] skip missing {bp}")
        return
    text = bp.read_text()
    if marker in text:
        print(f"[nxp-ese] already patched {bp.name} ({name_line})")
        return
    needle = f"cc_binary {{\n    {name_line},"
    if needle not in text:
        print(f"[nxp-ese] unexpected layout in {bp}: missing {name_line}")
        return
    repl = f"cc_binary {{\n    {name_line},\n    {marker}\n    enabled: false,"
    bp.write_text(text.replace(needle, repl, 1))
    print(f"[nxp-ese] disabled {name_line} in {bp.relative_to(SOURCE)}")


def main() -> None:
    for bp, name_line, marker in TARGETS:
        disable_binary(bp, name_line, marker)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Disable CLO soong mkdir modules that collide with AndroidBoardCommon.mk.

AOSPA mkdir.mk always emits a make recipe for LOCAL_SOONG_INSTALL_DIR, even
when the module is not in PRODUCT_PACKAGES. QCOM AndroidBoardCommon.mk (pulled
in because TARGET_FWK_SUPPORTS_FULL_VALUEADDS is true in AOSPA config.mk)
defines the same vendor/{firmware_mnt,bt_firmware,dsp} recipes.

cerro uses the AndroidBoardCommon rules (they also create rootfs symlinks).
Do not overlay whole device/qcom/common.

Idempotent. SOURCE_DIR defaults to repo source/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("SOURCE_DIR", ROOT / "source"))
BP = SOURCE / "device/qcom/common/Android.bp"
MARKER = "// AOSPA cerro: disabled; AndroidBoardCommon.mk owns this mountpoint"

NAMES = (
    "vendor_bt_firmware_mountpoint",
    "vendor_dsp_mountpoint",
    "vendor_firmware_mnt_mountpoint",
)


def disable_one(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    needle = f'mkdir {{\n    name: "{name}",'
    if f'name: "{name}"' in text and MARKER in text.split(f'name: "{name}"', 1)[-1][:400]:
        return text
    if needle not in text:
        print(f"[qcom-mkdir] unexpected layout: missing {name}")
        return text
    repl = f'mkdir {{\n    name: "{name}",\n    {MARKER}\n    enabled: false,'
    print(f"[qcom-mkdir] disabled {name}")
    return text.replace(needle, repl, 1)


def main() -> None:
    if not BP.is_file():
        print(f"[qcom-mkdir] skip missing {BP}")
        return
    text = BP.read_text()
    orig = text
    for name in NAMES:
        text = disable_one(text, name)
    if text == orig:
        print("[qcom-mkdir] already patched or unchanged")
        return
    BP.write_text(text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#
# AOSPA cerro: Lineage BoardConfigKernel, retargeted off vendor/voltage.
# Included from build/tasks/kernel.mk (after TARGET_OUT_INTERMEDIATES exists).

ifndef AOSPA_CERRO_BOARDCONFIG_KERNEL
AOSPA_CERRO_BOARDCONFIG_KERNEL := true

# $(call is-version-greater-or-equal,version_a,version_b)  version_a >= version_b
define is-version-greater-or-equal
$(strip \
  $(eval a_major := $(word 1,$(subst ., ,$(1)))) \
  $(eval a_minor := $(word 2,$(subst ., ,$(1)))) \
  $(eval b_major := $(word 1,$(subst ., ,$(2)))) \
  $(eval b_minor := $(word 2,$(subst ., ,$(2)))) \
  $(if $(call math_gt,$(a_major),$(b_major)),true, \
    $(if $(call math_gt_or_eq,$(a_major),$(b_major)), \
      $(if $(call math_gt_or_eq,$(a_minor),$(b_minor)),true,false), \
    false)) \
)
endef

# $(call is-version-lower-or-equal,version_a,version_b)  version_a <= version_b
define is-version-lower-or-equal
$(strip \
  $(eval a_major := $(word 1,$(subst ., ,$(1)))) \
  $(eval a_minor := $(word 2,$(subst ., ,$(1)))) \
  $(eval b_major := $(word 1,$(subst ., ,$(2)))) \
  $(eval b_minor := $(word 2,$(subst ., ,$(2)))) \
  $(if $(call math_lt,$(a_major),$(b_major)),true, \
    $(if $(call math_lt_or_eq,$(a_major),$(b_major)), \
      $(if $(call math_lt_or_eq,$(a_minor),$(b_minor)),true,false), \
    false)) \
)
endef

BUILD_TOP := $(abspath .)

TARGET_AUTO_KDIR := $(shell echo $(TARGET_DEVICE_DIR) | sed -e 's/^device/kernel/g')
TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE ?= $(TARGET_AUTO_KDIR)

TARGET_KERNEL_ARCH := $(strip $(TARGET_KERNEL_ARCH))
ifeq ($(TARGET_KERNEL_ARCH),)
    KERNEL_ARCH := $(TARGET_ARCH)
else
    KERNEL_ARCH := $(TARGET_KERNEL_ARCH)
endif

KERNEL_VERSION := $(shell grep -s "^VERSION = " $(TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE)/Makefile | awk '{ print $$3 }')
KERNEL_PATCHLEVEL := $(shell grep -s "^PATCHLEVEL = " $(TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE)/Makefile | awk '{ print $$3 }')
TARGET_KERNEL_VERSION ?= $(shell echo $(KERNEL_VERSION)"."$(KERNEL_PATCHLEVEL))

TARGET_KERNEL_NO_GCC ?= true

ifneq ($(KERNEL_VERSION),)
    ifeq ($(call is-version-greater-or-equal,$(TARGET_KERNEL_VERSION),6.11),true)
        TARGET_KERNEL_LIBC_SYSROOT_USE ?= host
    endif
endif

ifeq ($(TARGET_KERNEL_NO_GCC), true)
    KERNEL_NO_GCC := true
endif

ifneq ($(TARGET_KERNEL_CLANG_VERSION),)
    KERNEL_CLANG_VERSION := clang-$(TARGET_KERNEL_CLANG_VERSION)
else
    KERNEL_CLANG_VERSION := clang-stable
endif
TARGET_KERNEL_CLANG_PATH ?= $(BUILD_TOP)/prebuilts/clang/host/$(HOST_PREBUILT_TAG)/$(KERNEL_CLANG_VERSION)

TARGET_KERNEL_RUST_VERSION ?= stable

ifneq ($(USE_CCACHE),)
    ifneq ($(CCACHE_EXEC),)
        CCACHE_BIN := $(CCACHE_EXEC)
    endif
endif

KERNEL_MAKE_FLAGS :=

KERNEL_MAKE_FLAGS += \
    KBUILD_BUILD_USER="build-user" \
    KBUILD_BUILD_HOST="build-host"

KERNEL_MAKE_FLAGS += -j$(shell getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN)

TOOLS_PATH_OVERRIDE := \
    HIP_PATH=none PERL5LIB=$(BUILD_TOP)/prebuilts/tools-lineage/common/perl-base

ifneq ($(KERNEL_NO_GCC), true)
    GCC_PREBUILTS := $(BUILD_TOP)/prebuilts/gcc/$(HOST_PREBUILT_TAG)
    KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_arm64 := $(GCC_PREBUILTS)/aarch64/aarch64-linux-android-4.9/bin
    KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_arm64 := aarch64-linux-android-
    KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_arm := $(GCC_PREBUILTS)/arm/arm-linux-androideabi-4.9/bin
    KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_arm := arm-linux-androidkernel-
    KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_x86 := $(GCC_PREBUILTS)/x86/x86_64-linux-android-4.9/bin
    KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_x86 := x86_64-linux-androidkernel-

    TARGET_KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE_PREFIX := $(strip $(TARGET_KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE_PREFIX))
    ifneq ($(TARGET_KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE_PREFIX),)
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX ?= $(TARGET_KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE_PREFIX)
    else
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN ?= $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_$(KERNEL_ARCH))
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX ?= $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_$(KERNEL_ARCH))
    endif

    TARGET_KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE_PREFIX_ARM32 := $(strip $(TARGET_KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE_PREFIX_ARM32))
    ifneq ($(TARGET_KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE_PREFIX_ARM32),)
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_ARM32 ?= $(TARGET_KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE_PREFIX_ARM32)
    else
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_ARM32 ?= $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_arm)
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_ARM32 ?= $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_arm)
    endif

    ifeq ($(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN),)
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH := $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)
    else
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH := $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN)/$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)
    endif

    ifeq ($(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_ARM32),)
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH_ARM32 := $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_ARM32)
    else
        KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH_ARM32 := $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_ARM32)/$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX_ARM32)
    endif

    KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH_gcc := $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_$(KERNEL_ARCH))

    ifeq ($(KERNEL_ARCH),x86)
        KERNEL_MAKE_FLAGS += $(strip \
                                AR=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)ar \
                                NM=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)nm \
                                OBJCOPY=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)objcopy \
                                OBJDUMP=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)objdump \
                                READELF=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)readelf \
                                OBJSIZE=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)size \
                                STRIP=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)strip \
                                )
        ifeq ($(TARGET_KERNEL_CLANG_COMPILE),false)
            KERNEL_MAKE_FLAGS += $(strip \
                                    CC=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)gcc \
                                    LD=$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX)ld \
                                    )
        endif
    endif

    ifneq ($(TARGET_KERNEL_CLANG_COMPILE),false)
        KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE := CROSS_COMPILE="$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH)"
    else
        KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE := CROSS_COMPILE="$(CCACHE_BIN) $(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH)"
    endif

    ifeq ($(KERNEL_ARCH),arm64)
        KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE += CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32="$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH_ARM32)"
        KERNEL_CROSS_COMPILE += CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT="$(KERNEL_TOOLCHAIN_PATH_ARM32)"
    endif

    ifeq ($(TARGET_KERNEL_CLANG_COMPILE),false)
        ifeq ($(KERNEL_ARCH),arm)

# 0012 — 源码编译 kernel/nubia/sm8650（关掉 QCOM kernel-platform 预编译）

## 问题

kati 通过后 ninja 立刻失败：

```
ninja: 'device/qcom/pineapple-kernel/Image', needed by 'out/target/product/cerro/kernel', missing and no known rule to make it
```

官方 AOSPA 机型用预编译 `device/qcom/<platform>-kernel`。`device/qcom/common/dlkm/kernel-platform.mk` 在 `TARGET_FWK_SUPPORTS_FULL_VALUEADDS` + pineapple 6.1 时被 include，默认：

```
TARGET_USES_KERNEL_PLATFORM ?= true
TARGET_PREBUILT_KERNEL := device/qcom/pineapple-kernel/Image
PRODUCT_COPY_FILES += .../Image:kernel
```

AOSPA 没有 `vendor/aospa/build/tasks/kernel.mk`，也没有 `TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE` 的编译配方。cerro 的内核在 `kernel/nubia/sm8650`（local_manifest `cerro.xml`），229 上 Voltage 用 Lineage `vendor/voltage/build/tasks/kernel.mk` 编。229 也没有现成的 `pineapple-kernel` 预编译树。

## 决策

按 AGENTS：`TARGET_KERNEL_SOURCE := kernel/nubia/sm8650`，不要 `kernel_platform/` / bazel。

1. **产品 makefile 在 inherit `aospa-target.mk` 之前** 设 `TARGET_USES_KERNEL_PLATFORM := false`（`aospa_cerro.mk` + `sm8650-common/common.mk`）。`kernel-platform.mk` 用 `?=`，BoardConfig 太晚。
2. 把 Voltage/Lineage `kernel.mk` 放进 overlay `device/nubia/sm8650-common/build/tasks/kernel.mk`。AOSP `build/make/core/Makefile` 会 `-include device/*/*/build/tasks/*.mk`。
3. `build/BoardConfigKernel.mk` 从 Voltage `vendor/voltage/config/BoardConfigKernel.mk` 改写：不 inherit `vendor/voltage`；clang 用 `clang-stable`；rust 用 AOSPA `prebuilts/rust`；`merge_dtbs.py` 拷到 overlay `build/tools/`。由 **kernel.mk 在 tasks 阶段 include**（这时才有 `TARGET_OUT_INTERMEDIATES`）。
4. 缺的宿主工具用 local_manifest `cerro-kernel-tools.xml`：`prebuilts/kernel-build-tools`（AOSP `kernel/prebuilts/build-tools` @ `main-kernel-2025`）和 `prebuilts/tools-lineage`（Lineage @ `lineage-24.0`）。不要整仓 Voltage。
5. `TARGET_AUTO_COLLECT_KERNEL_MODULE_DEPS` 未接（cerro DT 也没开）。`TARGET_KERNEL_PLATFORM_TARGET` 保持空，不走 bazel `kernel/platform`。

## 重放

```bash
source scripts/proxy-env.sh
# 若 prebuilts/kernel-build-tools 还不在树里：
# bash scripts/sync-calcite.sh
bash scripts/apply-device-overlay.sh
cd source && source build/envsetup.sh && lunch aospa_cerro-userdebug
./rom-build.sh cerro
```

`apply-device-overlay.sh` 会把 `local_manifests/cerro-kernel-tools.xml` 拷进 `.repo/local_manifests/`；真正拉预编译树要再 `repo sync` 这两条。本机也可从 229 只读 rsync 这两份 prebuilts（不含 `.git`）。

## 验证

- `get_build_var TARGET_USES_KERNEL_PLATFORM` 为 `false`
- ninja 不再要 `device/qcom/pineapple-kernel/Image`
- `out/target/product/cerro/obj/KERNEL_OBJ/arch/arm64/boot/Image` 由 `kernel/nubia/sm8650` 生成
